name: Payment provider webhook (POST /webhooks/payments)
narrative_summary: The provider POSTs a signed JSON event. handle_webhook verifies the HMAC signature (unsigned or forged events are rejected), then dispatches refund.created to handle_refund (inserts a refund) and payment.succeeded to handle_payment_succeeded (marks the order paid).
state_lifecycle_summary: Inserts refunds rows or sets orders.status to paid.

steps.critical_assumptions_at_step: verify_signature rejects missing or wrong signatures
event is authentic, so amount/order_id are trusted
